name: AI data-centre operators

activities.name: AI data-centre operation
activities.in_scope_description: Owns or operates data centres that host AI training or inference workloads (GPU/accelerator capacity), as a material business
activities.out_of_scope_description: Supplies chips, servers, cooling or power to data centres that others own or operate; buys cloud capacity without owning or operating the data centres
contrast_statements: The company supplies equipment, chips or power to data centres run by others.
The company rents cloud capacity from others.
